entities.name: Jean Baptiste Henri Joseph Desmazières
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Baptiste Henri Joseph Desmazières was a merchant of Lille and an amateur mycologist. He was the editor of the scientific journals "Annales des sciences naturelles" and the "Bulletin de la société des sciences de Lille".
